{{Quote|More good news from the home office &hellip; LMC's closed another mine. Just a small one. Only 2,000 folks out of work this time and its way out in the Welsl system. (We didn't even know there was a Welsl system!) Looks like that "economic recovery" is well underway.|News report from the [[Invisible NewsStack]]|<ref name="FBS" />}}
The '''Welsl system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Lant Mining Corporation]] shut down a [[Mining/Legends|mine]] located in the system, resulting in 2,000 beings losing their jobs. When the [[Invisible NewsStack]] reported on the closure, they admitted that they were not even aware that the Welsl system existed.<ref name="FBS" />
